tour.title: Domain Overview: Package Docs
tour.description: Cargo Tracker is a Jakarta EE sample of Domain-Driven Design for cargo shipping. Start with the package docs that frame the layers: domain, application and shared kernel.

tour.title: Cargo Aggregate
tour.description: The Cargo aggregate is the heart of the model: route specification, itinerary, delivery progress and tracking ID.

tour.title: Handling, Location and Voyage
tour.description: Handling events record what happens to cargo. Locations and voyages describe where and how it moves. Repositories are domain-defined interfaces.

tour.title: Application Services
tour.description: Application services orchestrate use cases like booking, routing and handling registration, and publish events without holding business rules.

tour.title: Infrastructure: Persistence and Messaging
tour.description: JPA repositories implement the domain interfaces. JMS producers and consumers carry application events asynchronously.

tour.title: Interfaces: Booking Facade, REST and Web
tour.description: The booking facade maps domain objects to DTOs through assemblers. JSF backing beans, REST and WebSocket endpoints use it.

tour.title: Interfaces: Handling Event Intake
tour.description: Handling reports enter via REST, mobile and batch file upload, and become registration attempts.

tour.title: UI: JSF Pages and Templates
tour.description: Facelets pages and templates render the admin dashboard, booking, itinerary selection and public tracking.

tour.title: Pathfinder Routing Module
tour.description: A separate pathfinder package finds candidate transit paths; ExternalRoutingService adapts it as the domain's RoutingService.

tour.title: Configuration and Tests
tour.description: Deployment descriptors, persistence, batch job config and Arquillian tests, including the full lifecycle scenario test.
